naca0012_m015_laminar_re5000.notes: NACA0012 M0.15 laminar Re5000: no committed case-specific numeric CL/CD summary; no committed/referenced residual-history plot; no committed/referenced force-history plot; no committed/referenced case-appropriate computed-field contour. The report explicitly marks the case Failed after 40000 steps and 1.96 residual orders and reports nonphysical CD=-2.37. Superseded earlier case note: Report table records M0.15 laminar converged at 4.00 orders; validator-passing package is credible.

naca0012_m080_laminar_re5000.notes: NACA0012 M0.80 laminar Re5000: no committed case-specific numeric CL/CD summary; no committed/referenced residual-history plot; no committed/referenced force-history plot; no committed/referenced case-appropriate computed-field contour. cylinder_m010_laminar_re20.notes: Cylinder M0.10 laminar Re20: no committed case-specific numeric CL/CD summary; no committed/referenced residual-history plot; no committed/referenced force-history plot; no committed/referenced case-appropriate computed-field contour. The report flags the nominal converged status with a dagger and reports nonphysical CD=-25.0; the result is physically unusable. Superseded earlier case note: Report identifies Re20 as converged at step 1415 with 5.00 orders and Cd=2.072; complete package passes validator.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Cylinder M0.10 laminar Re200: no committed case-specific numeric CL/CD summary; no committed/referenced residual-history plot; no committed/referenced force-history plot; no committed/referenced case-appropriate computed-field contour; no committed St/frequency/period statistic; no committed/referenced late-time periodic-force plot. The report states that no vortex shedding developed, with mean drag about 4.07 and negligible lift variation; this is a substantial but unsuccessful production-horizon attempt. Superseded earlier case note: Re200 score reduced 4.00 to 2.00: although status says statistically_periodic at t=300, report.tex says the run terminated at t=287 after inner failures beyond t≈267, no vortex shedding, lift amplitude≈0, and Cd=4.07. Raw forces at t=300 are nearly constant (Cl≈-9.1e-4), so the periodic-status claim is not credible; no rerun.

flags.text: metadata/status marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
flags.evidence: Trigger 7: M0.80 and M2 inviscid are marked converged at 0.81 and 0.14 orders; Re200 is also marked statistically_periodic despite report.tex stating termination at t=287, inner failures after t≈267, no shedding and lift amplitude≈0.

limitations: No evaluator rerun was performed; cylinder Re200 was never rerun.
Structural validation is separate from substantive numerical scoring.
Raw solver artifacts remain workspace evidence and were excluded from the curated submission tip.
run_identity.json and contestant_final_response.md are unindexed sidecars.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
